summary: Hosts Git repositories and provides collaboration tools for issues, pull requests, CI and releases.
access_note: Free personal account; fine-grained or classic personal access tokens and OAuth/GitHub Apps are created in settings.

evidence.quote: You can also create an OAuth token with an OAuth app to access the REST API.
If you want to use the API for an organization or on behalf of another user, GitHub recommends that you use a GitHub App.
GitHub offers free and paid plans for storing and collaborating on code.
Every request to the REST API includes an HTTP method and a path.
The remote GitHub MCP Server is hosted by GitHub and provides the easiest method for getting up and running.

notes: GitHub also has a GraphQL API but no page on it was read, so api_styles lists rest only. Remote MCP URL appears in config examples on the repo README, not in a sentence. API access on the free plan is inferred from the free plan page; the REST docs do not state it.
